title: Prove uniform optimality of chronological rank-2/3 packing
body:
PR1960's exact optimizer produced a profile at one chosen exponent. This independent audit proves that the same profile minimizes every power bill for 0<q<1 in its fixed contiguous rank-2/3, cap-16, zero-extra-charge model. The selected source word and frontier are unchanged.

The package adds a written all-parameter majorization proof for the two nontrivial run families, an integer top-k partition checker, and a separately implemented exhaustive mass-vector oracle. Both read the pinned literal event archive and reconstruct both complete orientations. It corroborates Cinna Davis's profile and strengthens its optimality statement; it does not independently recertify the predecessor's numerical ceiling.

Evidence: 12 source run types; 641 runs per orientation; 2,753 type/vector pairs covering 23,499,934 chronological partitions across those types; 68,595 exact prefix checks. The complete profile has 162 merged blocks covering 365 calls and unchanged rank mass 5586. Six defect-sensitivity test groups cover removed detectors, corrupted/missing/duplicate/typed evidence, source drift, generation and optimized read-only relocation.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12.12 package replay passed after integration onto main 178a293edbd162fe3ce13e81a97af921366bd100; selected-record integrity and diff checks passed. No selected full cold replay, formal-kernel proof, human review, changed dirty-state circuit, hosting/precision/interface admission, or new kappa is claimed.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/chronological-rank23-majorization
```

Original assigned base 1d201395e037bd3fcb0175007fdcd0154878e613; predecessor PR1960 head df468539cb55e3c90e0dc492394450b162beeb56; exact source/member hashes and predecessor provenance are in TASK.json/SOURCES.json. The independent mathematical review records the files examined. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18929908 .

Credit Cinna Davis's chronological packing model and source census; selected gauge44 word/compiler/owner lineage, including Jeremy Kothe and Rohan Arun. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with separate asymptotic-proof and exact-verification specialists; Apache-2.0. Routine publication is part of the donated research assignment; no merge or frontier promotion requested.
